events.title: Introducing Don
events.summary: Hi, I'm Don. As Producer Ham mentioned, I'm the Global Project Manager for ArcheAge Chronicles.If you saw Ham's post, you know a bit about why I'm writing this. Now that XLGames is self-publishing AAC, the team wanted to show their commitment and vision. We wanted to be able to talk more directly and honestly with players about what we're building.So that's where I come in. My aim is to bring you insight into what is happening with development. It doesn't mean we won't mess up or make mistakes.
